title.narrative: Livelihoods recovery and micro-industry support project for communities affected by natural disasters

description.narrative: The overall aim of this project is to assist the rural communities to enhance their coping mechanisms with regard to natural disasters and, therewith, improve their household food security in a sustainable manner. As an agrarian society with a total population of around 4.5 million, about 80 percent of Eritreans live in rural areas and about 25 to 30 percent arenomads. The livelihoods of the rural people depend mostly on traditional farming, livestock production and fishing. Farming activities are frequently affected by natural disasters, mainly droughts, which hamper agricultural operations and sources of income of the rural communities. The fragile ecosystem in the region adds to the dramatic challenges in food security and poverty. The project will contribute to establish improved living conditions for the rural communities through addressing their immediate needs, especially revitalizing their major income generating agricultural activities. The project will, furthermore, support the local communities in the establishment of a variety of viable auxiliary economic activities in agro-industries thereby strengthen their household economy so they can contribute to their well-being on their own.
